===== somm =====
usage: somm [-h] [--version] [--project PROJECT]
            {chatgpt,status,cache-advice,generate,bench,tail,compare,frontier,workload,boundary,prompt,eval,optimize,campaign,inbox,plugin,mcp,skill,doctor,loop,prune,ledgers,fleet,mirror,alias,serve,spend,gpu,backfill-costs,plans,drain-spool} ...

somm — self-hosted LLM telemetry

positional arguments:
  {chatgpt,status,cache-advice,generate,bench,tail,compare,frontier,workload,boundary,prompt,eval,optimize,campaign,inbox,plugin,mcp,skill,doctor,loop,prune,ledgers,fleet,mirror,alias,serve,spend,gpu,backfill-costs,plans,drain-spool}
    chatgpt             Somm-owned ChatGPT subscription connection
    status              show call roll-up for the current project
    cache-advice        find low prefix-cache reuse opportunities
    generate            one-shot LLM call through somm
    bench               run latency and throughput probes
    tail                stream new calls as they land
    compare             run a prompt through N models side-by-side
    frontier            adequacy frontier per (provider, model) for one workload
    workload            register and inspect project workloads
    boundary            data boundary: route tiers, ledger audit, per-workload boundary
    prompt              manage prompt versions, labels, and A/B variants
    eval                promote datasets and run eval gates
    optimize            propose a prompt fork from failing graded calls
    campaign            run durable experiment campaigns
    inbox               list, show, apply, and dismiss recommendations
    plugin              list and inspect plugins, hooks, and providers
    mcp                 register the somm MCP server with coding agents
    skill               link the somm skill into coding agents' skill directories
    doctor              check config + ollama + db + intel + workers + cooldowns
    loop                run or schedule the intelligence loop (intel refresh, shadow grading,
                        recommendations)
    prune               delete calls (and their samples/updates/evals) older than a retention
                        window
    ledgers             every ledger on this machine: who writes it, its size, and the mirror gap
    fleet               per-project fleet health across registered ledgers
    mirror              the cross-project mirror (~/.somm/global.sqlite)
    alias               canonical model identities (list, seed, set)
    serve               run the web admin + HTTP API (localhost:7878)
    spend               today's LLM spend vs daily budget cap per workload
    gpu                 rented-GPU spend read from gipper receipts (read-only)
    backfill-costs      recompute cost_usd for $0 calls that now have pricing intel
    plans               metered-plan quota usage + pacing (PAYG vs metered, fleet-wide)
    drain-spool         replay spooled JSONL telemetry (written during DB outages) into the DB

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --project PROJECT     project name; also accepted after any command (default: $SOMM_PROJECT,
                        else this directory's project)

  --project PROJECT
  --since SINCE      window in days (default 7)
  --json             emit stable JSON

===== somm generate =====
usage: somm generate [-h] [--prompt-file PROMPT_FILE] [--image PATH_OR_URL] [--project PROJECT]
                     [--workload WORKLOAD] [--system SYSTEM] [--provider PROVIDER] [--model MODEL]
                     [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--temperature TEMPERATURE] [--json]
                     [--claude-cli-text-only]
                     [prompt]

positional arguments:
  prompt                prompt text, or '-' to read stdin

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
                        read prompt text from a file
  --image PATH_OR_URL   attach an image (file path or http(s) URL); repeatable. Routed only to
                        providers that accept images.
  --project PROJECT
  --workload WORKLOAD
  --system SYSTEM
  --provider PROVIDER
  --model MODEL
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
  --json                emit a machine-readable result
  --claude-cli-text-only
                        disable Claude CLI tools, MCP config, and settings; requires --provider
                        claude-cli

===== somm bench =====
usage: somm bench [-h] [--project PROJECT] {latency,throughput} ...

positional arguments:
  {latency,throughput}
    latency             run a latency benchmark
    throughput          run a throughput benchmark

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT

===== somm bench latency =====
usage: somm bench latency [-h] [--prompt-file PROMPT_FILE] [--project PROJECT]
                          [--workload WORKLOAD] [--provider PROVIDER] [--model MODEL]
                          [--iterations ITERATIONS] [--warmup WARMUP] [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS]
                          [--temperature TEMPERATURE] [--allow-fallback] [--json]
                          [prompt]

positional arguments:
  prompt                prompt text, or '-' to read stdin

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
                        read prompt text from a file
  --project PROJECT
  --workload WORKLOAD
  --provider PROVIDER
  --model MODEL
  --iterations ITERATIONS
  --warmup WARMUP
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
  --allow-fallback      let a failed --provider/--model pin be rescued by the router chain (off by
                        default: a benchmark that silently changes model measures nothing)
  --json                emit a machine-readable result

===== somm tail =====
usage: somm tail [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--workload WORKLOAD] [--since-minutes SINCE_MINUTES]
                 [--poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --workload WORKLOAD   filter to a single workload
  --since-minutes SINCE_MINUTES
                        start from N minutes ago (default: now)
  --poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL

===== somm compare =====
usage: somm compare [-h] --models MODELS [--project PROJECT] [--workload WORKLOAD]
                    [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--temperature TEMPERATURE] [--truncate TRUNCATE]
                    [--json]
                    prompt

positional arguments:
  prompt                the prompt text

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --models MODELS       provider/model (repeatable or comma-separated)
  --project PROJECT
  --workload WORKLOAD
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
  --truncate TRUNCATE   truncate response text at N chars (0 = no truncate)
  --json                emit JSON instead of the table

===== somm workload =====
usage: somm workload [-h] [--project PROJECT] {add,create,list,show,set-constraints} ...

positional arguments:
  {add,create,list,show,set-constraints}
    add (create)        register a workload in the project DB
    list                list registered workloads
    show                show one registered workload
    set-constraints     update workload adequacy constraints

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT

===== somm workload add =====
usage: somm workload add [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--description DESCRIPTION]
                         [--privacy-class {public,internal,private}]
                         [--from-example {freeform,structured-extraction}]
                         [--max-p95-latency-ms MAX_P95_LATENCY_MS]
                         [--max-p95-ttft-ms MAX_P95_TTFT_MS] [--max-tpot-ms MAX_TPOT_MS]
                         [--max-capability-failure-rate MAX_CAPABILITY_FAILURE_RATE]
                         [--max-cost-per-call-usd MAX_COST_PER_CALL_USD]
                         [--data-boundary {local,zdr,subscribed,unvetted}]
                         name

positional arguments:
  name                  workload name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --description DESCRIPTION
  --privacy-class {public,internal,private}
  --from-example {freeform,structured-extraction}
                        built-in workload template (default: freeform)
  --max-p95-latency-ms MAX_P95_LATENCY_MS
  --max-p95-ttft-ms MAX_P95_TTFT_MS
  --max-tpot-ms MAX_TPOT_MS
  --max-capability-failure-rate MAX_CAPABILITY_FAILURE_RATE
  --max-cost-per-call-usd MAX_COST_PER_CALL_USD
  --data-boundary {local,zdr,subscribed,unvetted}
                        loosest route tier this workload's data may reach (default: derive)

options:

  --max-p95-ttft-ms MAX_P95_TTFT_MS
  --max-tpot-ms MAX_TPOT_MS
  --max-capability-failure-rate MAX_CAPABILITY_FAILURE_RATE
  --max-cost-per-call-usd MAX_COST_PER_CALL_USD
  --clear               clear all workload constraints

===== somm boundary =====
usage: somm boundary [-h] [--project PROJECT] {routes,audit,set} ...

positional arguments:
  {routes,audit,set}
    routes            every configured route with its tier and basis
    audit             per workload: declared boundary vs the worst tier that served it
    set               set a workload's data boundary

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT

  --project PROJECT
  --json

===== somm prompt =====
usage: somm prompt [-h] [--project PROJECT] {list,show,register,fork,diff,label,promote,score} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,show,register,fork,diff,label,promote,score}
    list                list prompt versions for a workload
    show                show a prompt version or label
    register            register a new prompt version
    fork                fork a prompt from a version or label
    diff                diff two prompt versions or labels
    label               move a label to a version or weights
    promote             promote a version to a label
    score               show per-version eval rollups

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT

===== somm eval =====
usage: somm eval [-h] [--project PROJECT] {promote-call,import,run} ...

positional arguments:
  {promote-call,import,run}
    promote-call        copy a sampled call into a durable eval dataset
    import              import reviewed JSONL prompt/expected-response pairs
    run                 run a workload against a durable eval dataset

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT

  --project PROJECT

===== somm eval run =====
usage: somm eval run [-h] --workload WORKLOAD --dataset DATASET [--project PROJECT]
                     [--threshold THRESHOLD] [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--temperature TEMPERATURE]
                     [--provider PROVIDER] [--model MODEL]
                     [--reasoning-effort {none,minimal,low,medium,high,xhigh,max}]
                     [--implementation IMPLEMENTATION] [--judge-config JUDGE_CONFIG] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workload WORKLOAD
  --dataset DATASET
  --project PROJECT
  --threshold THRESHOLD
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
  --provider PROVIDER
  --model MODEL
  --reasoning-effort {none,minimal,low,medium,high,xhigh,max}
                        reasoning budget for models that dial it per request; sweeping this across
                        runs is how a model gets evaluated rather than assumed
  --implementation IMPLEMENTATION
                        explicit implementation coordinate, normally a Git commit SHA
  --judge-config JUDGE_CONFIG
                        JSON binary-rubric criteria and explicit judge panel
  --json

===== somm campaign run =====
usage: somm campaign run [-h] --workload WORKLOAD --dataset DATASET [--project PROJECT]
                         [--name NAME] [--metric {mean_score,pass_rate,error_rate}]
                         [--direction {gte,lte}] [--threshold THRESHOLD]
                         [--eval-threshold EVAL_THRESHOLD] [--max-rounds MAX_ROUNDS]
                         [--token-budget TOKEN_BUDGET] [--plateau-window PLATEAU_WINDOW]
                         [--min-delta MIN_DELTA] [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS]
                         [--temperature TEMPERATURE] [--provider PROVIDER] [--model MODEL]
                         [--log LOG] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workload WORKLOAD
  --dataset DATASET
  --project PROJECT
  --name NAME
  --metric {mean_score,pass_rate,error_rate}
  --direction {gte,lte}
  --threshold THRESHOLD
  --eval-threshold EVAL_THRESHOLD
  --max-rounds MAX_ROUNDS
  --token-budget TOKEN_BUDGET
  --plateau-window PLATEAU_WINDOW
  --min-delta MIN_DELTA
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
  --provider PROVIDER
  --model MODEL
  --log LOG
  --json

===== somm doctor =====
usage: somm doctor [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--max-exhausted-rate FRACTION] [--global]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --max-exhausted-rate FRACTION
                        regression gate: exit nonzero when the trailing-24h SommProvidersExhausted
                        rate exceeds FRACTION (e.g. 0.30). The rate is always printed; this flag
                        only affects the exit code — suitable for a cron/timer health check.
  --global              check ~/.somm/global.sqlite (every mirroring project) instead of this
                        project

===== somm loop =====
usage: somm loop [-h] [--project PROJECT] {run,install,uninstall,status} ...

positional arguments:
  {run,install,uninstall,status}
    run                 one pass: run the workers that are due, then exit
    install             write a systemd user timer that runs `somm loop run`
    uninstall           disable the timer for this project
    status              timer state and worker heartbeats

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT

===== somm loop run =====
usage: somm loop run [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--force] [--only {model_intel,shadow_eval,agent}]
                     [--all-projects] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --force               run every worker regardless of staleness
  --only {model_intel,shadow_eval,agent}
                        restrict to one worker (repeatable)
  --all-projects        every registered project ledger, not just this one
  --json

===== somm loop install =====
usage: somm loop install [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--every EVERY] [--no-enable]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --every EVERY      timer cadence (systemd span, default 15min)
  --no-enable        write units without enabling

===== somm loop uninstall =====
usage: somm loop uninstall [-h] [--project PROJECT]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT

  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --json

===== somm prune =====
usage: somm prune [-h] [--project PROJECT] --older-than DAYS [--dry-run] [--vacuum] [--global]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --older-than DAYS  retention window in days
  --dry-run          report counts without deleting
  --vacuum           reclaim file space afterwards
  --global           prune ~/.somm/global.sqlite instead of this project's ledger

===== somm ledgers =====
usage: somm ledgers [-h] [--scan DIR] [--json] {forget,adopt} ...

positional arguments:
  {forget,adopt}
    forget        remove a registration (never deletes a file)
    adopt         register an existing ledger

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --scan DIR      also list calls.sqlite files under DIR that are not registered
  --json

===== somm ledgers forget =====
usage: somm ledgers forget [-h] [--path PATH] [--dry-run] PROJECT

positional arguments:
  PROJECT

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --path PATH  forget only this one of its paths
  --dry-run

===== somm ledgers adopt =====
usage: somm ledgers adopt [-h] [--project NAME] [--dry-run] PATH

positional arguments:
  PATH

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --project NAME  register under this name (default: every project the file holds)
  --dry-run

===== somm mirror =====
usage: somm mirror [-h] [--project PROJECT] {sync} ...

positional arguments:
  {sync}
    sync             copy call rows a registered ledger has and the mirror lacks

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT  only this project's ledgers and rows

===== somm mirror sync =====
usage: somm mirror sync [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--dry-run] [--batch BATCH]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT  only this project's ledgers and rows
  --dry-run          count, copy nothing
  --batch BATCH      rows per transaction

===== somm alias =====
usage: somm alias [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--global] {list,seed,set} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,seed,set}
    list             show alias rows
    seed             derive aliases by rule from routes seen in the ledger
    set              map one provider/model route to a canonical id

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --global           operate on ~/.somm/global.sqlite

options:

  --project PROJECT
  --since SINCE      window in days (default 30)
  --path PATH        receipts directory (default: $SOMM_GIPPER_RECEIPTS, else
                     $GIPPER_DATA/receipts, else ~/.local/share/gipper/receipts)
  --json

===== somm plans =====
usage: somm plans [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--project-only] [--json] [--catalog] [--learn]
                  [--dry-run] [--min-events MIN_EVENTS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --project-only        count only this project's usage (default: whole fleet — quotas are shared)
  --json
  --catalog             list known plans from the bundled catalog (with sources + verified dates)
  --learn               write observed quota ceilings from recent 429s into plans.toml
  --dry-run             show learned limits without writing
  --min-events MIN_EVENTS
                        minimum quota-error events required to learn a ceiling
